results.name: (d) malformed writes are rejected by the rules

results.name: (e) killing the listener connection shows reconnecting, then polling, never a blank page
results.detail: Banner went "Đang kết nối lại…" (reconnecting) then "…tự kiểm tra thay đổi mỗi 30 giây" (polling every 30 s); 4 timeline rows stayed visible; recovered to Live after unblocking.

results.name: (e2) backend unreachable entirely: offline snapshot instead of a blank page
results.detail: Signed-in device: "Bản lưu ngoại tuyến: hiện không kết nối được máy chủ, nên đâ…" with 4 rows. New device: sign-in screen with "Hiện không kết nối được với Google…" and no plan content.

results.name: (f) confirmation gate: no change at 2 OK, applied at the 3rd OK, a single No freezes
results.detail: 2 OK: proposal pending, planRows JSON and table HTML identical in all sessions. 3rd OK: row applied (version 2), table version 2. One No: status rejected, rows JSON + table HTML byte-identical, vote buttons gone, server refused votes/edits on the frozen proposal, forged applies refused.

results.name: 72-hour reminder is posted exactly once
results.detail: Two signed-in sessions, one 73-hour-old pending proposal: 1 reminder document, reminderSent=true; a second reminder, an early (2-hour) reminder, and a free-text Coordinator reminder were refused by the rules; the reminder text is the fixed template.

results.name: edit shows 'đã sửa', soft delete shows 'Tin nhắn đã bị xoá' in the other session
results.detail: Edit flagged "đã sửa" live; delete kept the document (deleted=true, text cleared) and showed "Tin nhắn đã bị xoá".

results.name: chat loads 50 at a time and loads earlier messages on scroll up
results.detail: First render 50 messages; scrolling to the top loaded the rest (62 test messages + the seeded agent posts).

results.name: presence, reply threading, and draft autosave in the single chat
results.detail: No topic tabs; Nickie shown online to John; both posts stored in threads/general; reply quoted "Trả lời Nickie"; draft restored after reload.

results.name: one chat only: agent topics show as tags, filter works, replies inherit the topic, legacy threads stay out
results.detail: Legacy-thread message not shown, no tabs; tags render ("Vé máy bay"); filter chips Tất cả / Vé máy bay (2) / Ngân sách (1); a reply inherited the flights topic; filtering showed only that topic; posting while filtered reset the filter; every post stored in threads/general.

results.name: sign out works offline and leaves no plan or chat content behind
results.detail: Offline sign-out reached the sign-in screen in 5143 ms and stayed there while offline; it reloaded itself when back online and came back signed out, 0 fv-* storage keys, 0 rendered rows or messages.

results.name: (n) report issue: the side tab files one open issue under the reporter's name
results.detail: Nickie's report landed once in issues/ as an open 'stuck' report under her name, and the sheet confirmed it on screen.

results.name: (o) reception: an ack renders as a receipt line and the typing bar shows while the team is working
results.detail: The acknowledgement rendered as one compact receipt line (not a bubble), and the typing bar followed meta/typing on and off.

results.name: (p) thread stacking: a reply renders directly under its root, not at its own timestamp
results.detail: The reply to A rendered immediately under A (indented), ahead of the unrelated message B that arrived before it.

results.name: (q) thread collapse: threads start collapsed; the toggle on a root unfolds and folds its reply stack
results.detail: The thread rendered collapsed by default (toggle 'Xem 2 trả lời', aria-expanded=false, both replies incl. the nested one hidden, root visible); one click unfolded the stack, a second folded it again.

results.name: (r) agents answer like a chatbot inside one thread: root, ack, two role replies stay one block
results.detail: DOM order ["root1","r-ack-1","r-reply-coord","r-reply-scout","root2"] before and after reload; replies indented 40px / 40px with msg--thread; the second root (posted between the two replies) sits after the whole block. Agent writes simulated via emulator admin in the production document shape.

results.name: (s) an applied proposal updates the plan live in another member's open session (no reload)
results.detail: Nickie (open session, no reload) showed "Chỗ ở cập nhật trực tiếp" 201 ms after John's third OK; planMeta.version 1 -> 2 (exactly +1), table meta reads "phiên bản 2".

results.name: (t) a collapsed-by-default thread stays collapsed when a new reply or an ack arrives; an opened thread stays open; the count follows
results.detail: Collapsed by default at "Xem 2 trả lời"; a new reply arrived -> still collapsed, "Xem 3 trả lời" (aria-expanded=false); a later ack -> still collapsed, count still 3 (acks not counted); expanding showed all replies, and a further reply into the open thread kept it open ("Thu gọn 4 trả lời", visible).

results.name: (w) changing a vote while pending: OK -> No is allowed and freezes the proposal; No can never be undone
results.detail: Current behavior: a host can change their own OK to No while pending (UI keeps the No button enabled, rules allow prev ok -> no); that No freezes the proposal exactly like A2 (status rejected, rows unchanged, all vote buttons disabled). No -> OK and withdrawing an OK (ok -> pending) are refused by the rules.
